crossRefs.note: I teach you today, even you, So that your trust may be in Yahweh.
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.

to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.
Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

translations.web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
translations.bsb: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
translations.kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
translations.asv: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding:
